title: What If You Jumped Into a Hole Through the Earth? #shorts
description:
Guess before the end: 4 minutes, 40 minutes or 4 hours? Comment 1, 2 or 3!
A physicist worked it out with Earth's real density: about 38 minutes, at over 8 km per second in the middle.

Sources: Live Science (Klotz 2015, American Journal of Physics), Phys.org, Live Science (how hot is Earth's core)
